method: Public original-source pages, abstracts and official research summaries read through web search/open. This is not an independent replication of the cited studies. No competitor video footage or full transcripts were downloaded.

sources.title: Reducing Risks Posed by Synthetic Content
sources.support: Report covers provenance, watermarking and synthetic-content detection as distinct technical approaches.
sources.limits: Publication abstract reviewed; do not attribute a numerical detector accuracy or a universal solution to this report.

sources.title: C2PA FAQ
sources.support: Content Credentials record signed provenance and edits; metadata may be separated, with recovery mechanisms in some systems.
sources.limits: Provenance is not proof that the depicted event or caption is true. Absence of credentials is not proof of fabrication.

sources.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile, NIST AI 600-1
sources.support: Confabulation includes confidently stated erroneous or false content; human-AI configuration and information integrity are distinct risk areas.
sources.limits: Risk framework, not a benchmark of every current model; no universal hallucination rate.

sources.title: An Audit on the Perspectives and Challenges of Hallucinations in NLP
sources.support: Audit of 103 publications and survey of 171 practitioners identifies inconsistent definitions of hallucination.
sources.limits: Abstract reviewed. Does not establish one failure rate or show every incorrect answer is intentionally deceptive.

sources.title: Large Language Models explained briefly
sources.support: Original creator's introduction to LLMs, pretraining and transformers; search metadata showed 7,612,650 views during planning.
sources.limits: Search metadata and description only, not full video inspection. View count is an index snapshot, not current live measurement. No copying animation, script or music.

sources.title: Bad Bot Report 2026: Bots in the Agentic Age
sources.support: Vendor's 2026 report summary states automated traffic exceeded 53% of web traffic in 2025.
sources.limits: Vendor measurement and classification, not a census of all people, accounts, posts or videos. Automated traffic includes non-generative automation. Use year 2025 for underlying data.

sources.title: AI models collapse when trained on recursively generated data
sources.support: Research studies degradation under recursive training on generated data.
sources.limits: Specific experimental assumptions; does not establish inevitable collapse for all uses of synthetic data. Pair with S08. Article has a 2025 author correction; avoid unrechecked detailed formulas or numbers.

sources.title: Is Model Collapse Inevitable? Breaking the Curse of Recursion by Accumulating Real and Synthetic Data
sources.support: Under tested settings, accumulating synthetic data alongside original real data avoids collapse observed under replacement.
sources.limits: Research preprint abstract; no blanket guarantee for all production training pipelines.

sources.title: Generative AI and jobs: A 2025 update
sources.support: About one in four workers worldwide is in an occupation with some GenAI exposure; transformation is more likely than full replacement for most jobs.
sources.limits: Potential task exposure, not measured layoffs or a personal job-loss forecast. Global estimate not Taiwan-specific.

sources.title: Navigating the Jagged Technological Frontier
sources.support: Field experiment involving 758 BCG consultants; AI assistance works unevenly across tasks, motivating task-level evaluation.
sources.limits: Historical study of specified tasks and models; not a 2026 product ranking or guarantee for any occupation. Do not compare a participant's work directly with IMO scores.

sources.title: Advanced version of Gemini with Deep Think officially achieves gold-medal standard at the IMO
sources.support: Advanced system solved five of six 2025 IMO problems for 35/42 points; announcement reports official grading and natural-language solutions within contest time limits.
sources.limits: An advanced evaluated system, not every consumer app or every model. Historical 2025 result, not latest ranking. No claim the same model failed an unrelated example.

sources.title: International AI Safety Report 2026
sources.support: Scientific synthesis addressing general-purpose AI capabilities, limitations and risks.
sources.limits: Use as background cross-check, not evidence for invented numerical trends or a named product failure.

sources.title: Towards understanding sycophancy in language models
sources.support: Five tested assistants exhibited sycophancy across four tasks; preference feedback can favor answers matching user beliefs.
sources.limits: Historical research conditions; no claim all current assistants always agree, possess motives, or cause a particular individual outcome.

sources.title: Disclosing use of GenAI content
sources.support: Realistic and meaningfully AI-generated/altered content must be disclosed; disclosed content is not automatically ineligible for monetization.
sources.limits: Check current upload UI and requirements on actual publication date.

sources.title: YouTube channel monetization policies
sources.support: Original value matters; repetitive, mass-produced and minimally transformed reused content can be ineligible.
sources.limits: No promise of monetization approval. Synthetic voice itself is not a blanket ban.

sources.title: AI Generated Videos Just Changed Forever
sources.support: English packaging reference; planning search metadata showed 9,236,970 views.
sources.limits: Historical large-channel example; metadata/description inspection only. No inference of new-channel success probability or permission to reuse footage.
